# Aman Hanspal

> Official portfolio of Aman Hanspal, an AI/ML Engineer based in Mumbai, India, building generative AI systems across image, video, audio, and language.

Aman Hanspal works on multimodal AI, retrieval-augmented generation, computer vision, speech systems, diffusion models, document intelligence, and production-oriented AI engineering. He was a Generative AI Researcher at Aeos Labs from May 2024 to January 2026.

## Primary Resources

- [Portfolio](https://amanhanspal.com/): Experience, projects, skills, education, recognition, and contact information.
- [Resume](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gbexqkeLpnsJU6dc9_Y0qOPreeYYC72Q/view): Professional resume.

## Selected Projects

- [Clip-It](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/Clip-IT): Local-first multimodal video search using OpenCLIP, Whisper, LanceDB, FastAPI, React, and Electron.
- [VisionQuery](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/VisionQuery): Natural-language video search using YOLO-World open-vocabulary detection.
- [SIGGRAPH 2025 RAG Search](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/siggraph-rag-aim): Hybrid retrieval and cited LLM answers over SIGGRAPH papers.
- [RAG ChatBot for Tata Motors](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/tata-advanced-rag): Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation with hybrid retrieval, reranking, and RAGAS evaluation.
- [Speech-to-Speech](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/speech-to-speech): English-to-Indian-regional-language speech research and implementation.
- [ReVision AI](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/ReVision-AI): Agentic study companion that turns lecture videos into grounded study materials.
- [Note-It](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/Note-It): Desktop learning agent that creates structured Notion notes from educational videos.
- [Pinterest Scraper](https://github.com/aman-hanspal/pinterest-scraper): Open-source Python package for searching and downloading Pinterest images.
